Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the fix (null stop_reason and stop_sequence on the InvokeModel stream message_start event) and the affected provider (bedrock). The changeset adds these two keys to the message_start map in core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go, adds a regression test, and adds a changelog entry. The title is specific and matches the main change. It is 89 characters, which is slightly long but acceptable.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template closely. It has a Summary that states the problem and cause, a Changes list covering the code, test, and changelog, a Type of change section with Bug fix checked, an Affected areas section with Core and Providers checked, a How to test section with commands and expected results, a Breaking changes section marked No, and a Related issues section linking `#9538`. Some template sections are missing or thin: the Checklist is absent, Security considerations is absent, and the How to test block does not include the UI or full go test ./... steps. The author also states the test was not run against live Bedrock. These gaps are non-critical, so the description is mostly complete.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to include `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR summary states that `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `message_start` literal map (+4/-0). Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys are serialized. The unit test `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields` asserts that both keys are present and nil. The previous review read the code and test directly and confirmed them. In this review, a repository read of `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` at head was truncated before the `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes` region, and the whole-PR diff was unavailable because changed blobs are missing from the checkout. The code-level conclusion therefore rests on the previous direct reading and the current summary, not on a fresh read. The e2e case in `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` was not read. It is a supporting test and does not change the verdict.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The PR changes are: two nil-valued keys in the `message_start` map in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go`; one regression test in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`; a changelog entry in `core/changelog.md`; and an e2e regression case in `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` for the Bedrock `invoke-with-response-stream` `message_start` keys. The code, test, and e2e case all implement [`#9538`]. The changelog documents the same change. No unrelated change is identified. The `message_delta` branch and the `message_start.usage` behavior from [`#5885`] are not changed according to the summary. The diff of `invoke.go` could not be read in full in this review, so the in-scope conclusion relies on the previous review and the change summary.
